answer: Photonic attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by binding agent identities to physical unclonable functions. Agents deployed across a meadow authenticate by shining laser pulses through an opal crystal seated on a marble base, generating unique speckle diffraction patterns. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware cost of fabricating distinct optical tokens per persona. However, condensation and micro-scratches can perturb diffraction paths, falsely rejecting legitimate agents.
